ai-music-muse 1.0.3

- Added package.json file for enhanced environment/configuration support.
- Updated skill description and keywords for clearer usage and more accurate trigger scenarios.
- Minor text adjustments: shortened some trigger words and simplified instructions.
- Result display and guide URLs now use a dynamic variable ({REGISTER_URL}) for consistency.
- Skill name in SKILL.md changed from "muse" to "muse ai".

Muse v1.0.1 — AI 音乐创作助手  
帮助用户在对话中自助制作歌曲、BGM与歌词，支持三大模式与认证注册全流程，多轮交互即可获原创音乐。

- 支持灵感、定制、纯音乐三种创作模式，自动识别用户意图并分流。
- 全面重构认证流程，未注册/Token 过期自动引导注册并粘贴 Token 验证。
- 多步交互采集音乐要素（风格、音色、情绪、歌词等）并确认生成设置。
